question: footway geojson export lisbon
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 10

question: residential roads wkt text
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' LIMIT 10

question: tertiary centerpoints lon lat
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS lon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary' LIMIT 10

question: service roads length km rounded 2 decimals
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' LIMIT 10

question: secondary road labels formatted
sql: SELECT id, CONCAT(COALESCE(names.primary, 'unnamed'), ' (', class, ')') AS label FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' LIMIT 10

question: steps start coords lonlat string rounded
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS start_lat, CAST(ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS VARCHAR) AS lonlat_str FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'steps' LIMIT 10
